description: DEPRECATED — signs with a private key sent to the server (the key transits the network; this tool proxies to /market/sign). Agents must sign locally with their own SDK instead, then submit txBytes+publicKey+signature to the signature-based endpoints (e.g. prepare_payment → local sign → complete_task). Kept for operator/demo use only (ALLOW_KEY_ENDPOINTS).

privateKey.description: Private key (DER-encoded hex like 302e... or 0x-prefixed ECDSA hex)

txBytes.description: Base64-encoded frozen transaction bytes from prepare_payment

name: sign_transaction
